Riverside Public Schools - Special Education Department
Notice of IEP Team Meeting

Student: A. M.
School: Cedar Park Middle School
Grade: 6
Date of notice: January 12, 2026

Purpose of meeting
Annual review of the Individualized Education Program (IEP) and consideration of extended school
year services.

Meeting details
Date: Thursday, February 5, 2026
Time: 3:15 p.m. - 4:15 p.m.
Location: Cedar Park Middle School, Room 12 (conference room, main office entrance)
Virtual option: A video link will be sent to the email address on file one day before the meeting.

Team members invited
- Parent/guardian
- Special education teacher: Ms. Whitfield
- General education teacher: Mr. Okafor
- School psychologist: Dr. Lin
- Speech-language pathologist: Ms. Duarte
- Local education agency representative: Ms. Grant
- Student (invited, may attend part of the meeting)

Current services and accommodations
- 30 minutes per week of speech-language services in a small group.
- Extended time (1.5x) on tests in all classes.
- Preferential seating near the front of the room.
- Access to a printed copy of notes for science and social studies.
- Movement breaks as needed during long class periods.

Draft goals to review
1. Reading comprehension: identify main idea and two supporting details in grade-level text with
   80 percent accuracy across three consecutive probes.
2. Writing: produce a three-paragraph informational response with an introduction, two detail
   paragraphs, and a conclusion in 40 minutes with graphic organizer support.
3. Self-advocacy: request a break or clarification using an agreed signal in four of five classes.

What to bring
Any reports from outside providers, and questions about the draft goals.

If you cannot attend
You may request a new meeting time, send written comments before the meeting, or bring an advocate.
Please reply to the case manager by Friday, January 30, 2026 so interpretation services, if needed,
can be arranged.

Contact
Case manager: Ms. Whitfield, Special Education, Cedar Park Middle School
